summary.text: Jill Haffley is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having won the June 30, 2026 Republican primary.
A retired teacher, she has served on the Colorado Springs School District 11 Board of Education since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Jill Haffley earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Colorado, Colorado Springs in 1990 and a graduate degree from the University of Northern Colorado in 2000, and her career experience includes working as a teacher.
She is an at-large member of the Colorado Springs School District 11 school board, took office on December 6, 2023, and her current term ends in 2027.
